title: 1518년 스트라스부르의 춤

images.prompt: Strasbourg, July 1518, late-medieval Alsace: an empty narrow cobbled street of tall half-timbered houses at dusk; in the middle a single faceless silhouette of a woman in a long 16th-century dress caught mid-spin, dancing alone, arms raised; in a dark doorway to the side, two tall faceless silhouettes of men in long black robes and caps stand still, watching her. No musicians, no instruments anywhere. Long shadows on the stones.

Strasbourg, July 1518, late-medieval Alsace: a wide view of the old city at a hazy summer dusk: steep tiled roofs, half-timbered houses and the tall gothic cathedral spire rising above, the river in front, warm dim light, completely quiet.

Strasbourg, July 1518, late-medieval Alsace: a narrow cobbled alley with shuttered windows at night under one lantern; a lone small faceless silhouette of a woman in a long dress spins with arms raised in the middle of the alley, seen from far behind; no musicians, nobody else.

Strasbourg, July 1518, late-medieval Alsace: a cobbled street at dusk lined with half-timbered houses; several faceless dark silhouettes of ordinary townspeople, men and women in 16th-century clothes, standing in their open doorways and at the street edge, and two or three of them stepping forward onto the cobblestones as if starting to dance, seen from a distance, warm window light.

Strasbourg, July 1518, late-medieval Alsace: seen from a high window: a crowded cobbled street packed with dozens of faceless silhouettes all dancing at once, peasants and richly dressed burghers mixed together, long evening shadows, no musicians.

Strasbourg, July 1518, late-medieval Alsace: a dim study at night: a heavy wooden table with a single candle, old books and parchment (writing blurred and unreadable), two faceless silhouettes of physicians in long dark robes seen from behind, leaning over the table.

Strasbourg, July 1518, late-medieval Alsace: a wooden stage built in the middle of a market square at dusk, faceless silhouettes of musicians with fiddles, pipes and a drum standing on it, the square still empty around it, torches on poles.

Strasbourg, July 1518, late-medieval Alsace: night, the market square and the wooden stage completely filled with hundreds of faceless dark silhouettes whirling endlessly, torchlight flickering, musicians tiny on the stage, an overwhelming sea of moving figures seen from far above.

Strasbourg, 1518: a silent empty market square at night lit by one hanging lantern, the cobblestones filling the frame edge to edge; in the foreground broken wooden stage planks lie on the ground with an abandoned drum and tambourine beside them; on the far house walls only long moving shadows of dancers are cast, the dancers themselves not visible.

Strasbourg, July 1518, late-medieval Alsace: a wooden cart seen from far behind climbing a steep forest path up a hill at dusk toward a small stone chapel with warm candlelight in its doorway; faceless silhouettes sit huddled in the cart.

youtube.summary: 1518년 여름 스트라스부르. 한 여자의 춤이 번지자, 도시는 무대를 세우고 악사를 불렀습니다. 그 뒤로 춤추는 사람은 더 늘어났습니다.

sources: 출처: Britannica 'Dancing plague of 1518', Public Domain Review(2018), John Waller(The Lancet, 2009), The Psychologist(BPS)
threads: 1518년 7월 스트라스부르. 어떤 여자가 음악도 없는 골목에서 혼자 춤을 추기 시작했어. 쓰러질 때까지 추고, 깨면 또 추고. 기록마다 나흘에서 일주일이래.
근데 일주일 만에 30명 넘게 따라 추기 시작함. 남자 여자, 신분 상관없이.
더 이상한 건 시의 대응이야. 의사들이 '피가 뜨거워진 병'이라고 하니까, 시가 상인 조합 회관 내주고 시장에 무대 세우고 악사까지 불렀어. 더 춤춰서 털어내라고.
결과는? 연주 울릴수록 사람이 더 늘었대. 당시 기록 하나는 한 달 만에 400명이라고 적었고. 결국 9월까지 춤이랑 음악을 금지해 버림.
끝은 더 기묘해. 영상으로 보려면 인스타 @ossak_alarm 에서 봐.
